scenarios.title: Crisis management — Urban Weave
scenarios.inspiration: American Eagle jeans campaign controversy 2025; American Airlines mitigation strategies.
scenarios.situation: At 8:00 AM, Urban Weave launches "DNA-Fit" with AI-generated copy: "Superior genetics engineered into every thread. Weed out the weak designs in your closet." By 10:00 AM, viral hijacking on X/TikTok (eugenics, body shaming). You are the retained crisis agency.
constraints: 2 hours for a complete multi-channel response
No deletion without detailed explanation (cover-up risk)
Absolute, empathetic apologies—no defensive legal or AI phrasing
scenarios.critiqueFocus: Apology prompt structure: no defensive passive voice; authentic avatar emotion.
scenarios.briefMarkdown:
## Urban Weave — DNA-Fit crisis

**Context**: automated AI campaign, offensive viral phrase.

**Your role**: external crisis communication agency.

**Deadline**: 2h rush.

**Deliverables**: holding statement, internal memo, apology visual, 45s CMO video.

**Tone**: absolute empathy, accountability, zero "sorry if offended."
scenarios.narrationScript: Sprint Scenario A. Urban Weave is in viral crisis this morning. You have two hours. I'll present the situation, CEO constraints, and four expected deliverables. Then you produce with your tools. Grand Oral will focus on your apology prompt and video emotion.

interactionScripts.1: Issue Urban Weave mission with 2h rush checklist and tone constraints.
interactionScripts.2: Grand Oral: apology prompt, legal risks, text-image-video coherence.

scenarios.title: Greenwashing — Lumina Tech
scenarios.inspiration: Target identity crisis; Campbell's ESG backlash controversies.
scenarios.situation: Lumina Tech campaigned on a "100% carbon neutral" flagship phone. Investigative report exposes toxic runoff from its Southeast Asian manufacturer. Boycott from activists + shareholder pressure.
constraints: Pivot to radical transparency, not pure denial
EU AI Act Article 50 on all new synthetic assets
deliverables: Customer service FAQ (prompt with bans tags)
30s infographic script from audit excerpt below (Knowlify/Claude)
scenarios.critiqueFocus: Firefly vs Midjourney choice; no hallucinated environmental promises.
scenarios.briefMarkdown:
## Lumina Tech — Greenwashing pivot

**Context**: contested carbon campaign, toxic manufacturing report.

### Audit report excerpt (sole source — do not invent)

- Partner plant **Shenzhen GreenParts**: estimated Scope 3 emissions **4.2 Mt CO₂e/year** (EcoTrace audit, Jan 2026).
- Marketing claim "100% carbon neutral": **unsupported** for manufacturing phase; offset covers European logistics only.
- Recommendation: remove "carbon neutral" visuals and publish FAQ with data above.

**Stake**: activists + shareholders.

**Deliverables**: customer FAQ, transparency banners, 30s investor LinkedIn script.

**Prompt bans**: delve, intricate, misunderstanding—absolute accountability tone.
scenarios.narrationScript: Sprint Scenario B. Lumina must pivot under media and legal pressure. EU AI Act compliance mandatory on new visuals. I'll detail deliverables and the Midjourney trap. Two hours for a credible kit.

interactionScripts.1: Lumina mission: transparency pivot, checklist, XML semantic bans.
interactionScripts.2: Grand Oral: IP compliance, non-hallucinated promises, narrative coherence.

scenarios.title: Friday news dump — FinVault
scenarios.inspiration: OpenAI 2023 leadership transition; weekend press release failures.
scenarios.situation: Friday 4:30 PM: FinVault's board ousts the charismatic founder. Sterile 3-sentence release. Rumors of bankruptcy, SEC raids, data breaches trend on LinkedIn/X. Engineers threaten mass resignation. Interim CEO unavailable to film.
constraints: No CEO shoot: authorized AI voiceover + b-roll
Stability, continuity, gratitude toward departing founder
deliverables: Enterprise client email + engineer Slack + interim CEO LinkedIn post
scenarios.critiqueFocus: Narrative cohesion across text-image-video; strip typical AI crisis hyperbole.
scenarios.briefMarkdown:
## FinVault — Weekend stabilization

**Context**: founder ouster, viral rumors, failed Friday news dump.

**Constraint**: interim CEO won't film—campus b-roll + voiceover.

**Deliverables**: 3 targeted texts, Q3 visual roadmap, 45s reassurance video.

**Tone**: unwavering, professional, no catastrophe hyperbole.
scenarios.narrationScript: Sprint Scenario C. FinVault is turbulent this weekend. Stabilize before Monday market open. No on-camera CEO—voiceover and b-roll workflow. I'll present three distinct texts and the reassurance video.

interactionScripts.1: FinVault mission: weekend rush, stability tone, no CEO filming.
interactionScripts.2: Grand Oral: multi-channel cohesion, strip AI hyperbole, psychological viability.
